author: GamingBolt
description:
Resident Evil Requiem is chock full of secrets and references to previous titles as long as you're willing to look for them as hard as you can. From specific pathways and callbacks to Leon's time at the RCPD to the return of a fan-favorite secret character, there's a lot to track down if you're trying to discover just how creative the developer can get when it comes to hiding things in plain sight. 

We’ve spent a fair bit of time trying to find as many as we could and, of course, couldn’t wait to share them with you. Join us on a fun trip to Resident Evil’s memory lane. You might be surprised at what you find there!
title: 15 COOL Resident Evil Requiem Secrets You LIKELY Missed

author: GamingBolt
description:
Was there ever any doubt that Resident Evil Requiem would end up as successful as it has? After launching last week following extensive praise from critics – currently an 88 Metascore based on a whopping 121 reviews – the return to Raccoon City didn't just surpass expectations – it blew them out of the water. The concurrent player count on Steam peaked at 344,214. That's more than triple of Resident Evil Village. But wait, there's more. 

Resident Evil Requiem is currently rated “Overwhelmingly Positive,” with 96 percent of nearly 22,000 users giving it the thumbs-up.
title: Why Are MILLIONS of Gamers Addicated To Resident Evil Requiem?
